notes.title: DATAMINERS - New trailer and gameplay reveal!
notes.content:
[h2]New Trailer and updated store page! [/h2][p]I am happy to announce that Dataminers has a new trailer and gameplay video![/p][p]The store page has been updated and now introduces the various game modes of Dataminers.[/p][p][b]Take a look! :)[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]About Dataminers[/h3][p]Dataminers takes Minesweeper to the next level and puts you right in the middle of the action: hack the mines around you to advance on the cleared fields. Sounds simple? Dataminers is easy to learn but hard to master![/p][p]Challenge yourself in a variety of game modes with a ton of difficulty settings, level progression and unlockables.[/p][p][/p][h3]ASHGAMES Publisher Sale 2025[/h3][p]We're part of the ASHGAMES Publisher Sale 2025. We'll run multiple streaming events and announce them here. Apologies if you see several announcements.  
[/p][p] [/p][h3]Gameplay[/h3][p]The Mining Sessions give a sneak peek into the different game modes of Dataminers. [/p][p]Watch the broadcast on the store page: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518490/Dataminers/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518490/Dataminers/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Turnbased Carnival - DATAMINERS Mining Sessions
notes.content:
[h3]Event Information[/h3]
We're part of Turnbased Carnival 2023. We'll run multiple streaming events and announce them here. Apologies if you see several announcements.

[h3]About Dataminers[/h3]
Dataminers is a fast turn-based roguelike where you climb and clear towers full of data. Infiltrate highly secured data centres and grab as much data as you can. Plan your moves and outsmart guards, cameras and drones. Every turn counts: the Security Grid is already rising. Valuable equipment is hidden in protected terminals. Steal it and use it for your mission or sell it on the black market.

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
The Mining Sessions show the current state of the Alpha version of Dataminers.

Watch the broadcast on the store page:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518490/Dataminers/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2518490/Dataminers/[/url]
